_comment: App Store privacy nutrition labels for io.github.glandais.whereiwas.
An empty dataUsages array declares DATA_NOT_COLLECTED for every category.
Rationale: Apple defines collection as transmitting data off the device and
retaining it beyond what is needed to service the request in real time. The app
reads precise location, motion activity and battery state, filters them and
writes them to a local SwiftData database. Nothing is transmitted: there is no
networking code, no account, no analytics and no third-party SDK in the target.
Exports are initiated by the user, to a destination the user chooses, which is a
user action rather than collection by the developer. Apple Maps tiles on the map
screen are drawn by MapKit, a system framework, and are not developer collection.
Revisit this file the moment an upload layer, analytics or any SDK is added.
Apply with: asc web privacy plan|apply|publish --app 6808349924 --file metadata/app-privacy.json
